Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
PAPERS, PLEASE — LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess)

CONTROLS / UI
- Documents spawn on the counter's left (~0.155, 0.78–0.80); drag to desk to open/read. Docs sometimes render INVISIBLE but are still grabbable at counter spawn (~0.165, 0.79) — always probe there before concluding a document is missing.
- RETURN documents by dragging UP into the window mouth (~0.15, 0.57). Drops on sill, counter, desk, or near top (~y0.30) fail.
- NEXT! = black call box on the pole (~0.302, 0.223). Clicks cycle tooltips when blocked. Two presses per entrant is typical (one to dismiss, one to summon).
- Gold lever (~0.30, 0.335–0.36) toggles shutter.
- Stamp drawer: right-edge tab (~0.99, 0.44–0.50); tab position shifts, click visible protrusion. Inspect mode appears to BLOCK drawer opening and dragging — toggle inspect off first.
- STAMPING: drag passport so the dashed ENTRY VISA box top edge sits just under the rail bar, centered under chosen head, then click knob. APPROVED knob ~(0.86–0.90, 0.34–0.41); DENIED ~(0.655–0.675, 0.375–0.44) — varies with rail layout; read knob position per screen. Impression prints at fixed spot just below the bar at head's x. Marks at/straddling the box's top border/header are repeatedly ACCEPTED. Verify by dragging doc down after stamping. Moving the doc: grab data rows below the bar (avoid rail/knobs); small drags.
- Rail-extended state has coincided with stalled NEXT!; retracting rail restores advancement. Leftover papers on desk (ads, citations, tickets) BLOCK NEXT! — return every document and keep the desk clear.
- Bulletin: page-flip by clicking the dog-ear at the page's bottom-right corner (~0.765–0.78, 0.905–0.965; position shifts per page). 'CHECK ALL PAGES' does nothing. Park bulletin in bottom-left storage slot (~0.225, 0.93); bottom-right covers inspect button.
- Rulebook: drag notebook icon (~0.216, 0.886–0.92) onto desk lower area (~0.35, 0.75). Opens CONTENTS; click 'Basic Rules' text (~0.48, 0.663). RULES page often renders BLANK; dropping after the no-docs notice can show entries ('passport', 'All documents must be current', 'Foreigners require an entry ticket'). Stow via drag back to icon.
- INSPECT MODE: red button bottom-right (~0.965, 0.93). Red frame + 'HIGHLIGHT DISCREPANCIES'; clicks toggle white outlines on items; toggling off clears selections; invalid pairings show 'NO CORRELATION'.
- DOCUMENTLESS ENTRANTS: notice 'THIS ENTRANT HAS NO DOCUMENTS — use INSPECT mode'. Workflow: inspect on → highlight pertinent rulebook entry + counter (dotted link forms) → click NEXT! → 'DISCREPANCY DETECTED' + INTERROGATE button (~0.17, 0.855) → dialogue → NEXT! refuses them (no citation, 'COME BACK AT 6AM TOMORROW').
- Audio Transcript is a toolbar icon next to the rulebook; UNTESTED for verifying entrant statements.
- Pause: Escape. NO mid-shift save — only day restart (Main Menu → STORY → day select) recovers softlocks.
- End-of-day: family statuses screen, SLEEP (~0.92, 0.90); ledger with SAVINGS/SALARY/RENT/HEAT/FOOD/MEDICINE checkboxes (~x0.69; rent y≈0.575, heat≈0.617, food≈0.659). Rent is mandatory. Unchecking HEAT freed funds to select FOOD on Day 1. Day 2 SLEEP skipped straight to next newspaper (no ledger seen).
- WALK TO WORK button ~(0.5, 0.925) → black fade → title card (click) → booth.
- Salary depends on speed; applicants after 6PM are unpaid.

RULES BY DAY
- Day 1 (82.11.23): stamp ENTRY VISA; admit Arstotzkan citizens only; deny ALL foreigners; no citizen ID card needed.
- Day 2 (82.11.24): foreigners with valid passports admitted; deny expired/contradictory docs.
- Day 3 (82.11.25): all foreigners require a valid ENTRY TICKET bearing today's date.
- Day 4 (82.11.26): Arstotzkan citizens must show ID CARD (compare DOB vs passport, weight vs scale); foreigners require a valid ENTRY PERMIT — 'Enter by' date not past, name and passport number matching the passport, purpose/duration matching spoken statements.

CITATIONS / ERRORS OBSERVED
- Approving a photo-mismatched doc → WARNING, no penalty (appearance mismatches are unreliable; never deny on appearance).
- Narrow U.F. city 'Great Rapid' draws an 'Invalid Issuing City' citation — but later DENYING a U.F./Great Rapid passport gave 'Applicant clear for entry' LAST WARNING - NO PENALTY, implying the passport was valid; treat issuing-city flags with caution (rulebook city list renders blank, so it can't be verified).
- Denying a valid entrant (missing ticket that was actually invisible) → WARNING; now at LAST WARNING stage — further mistakes risk credit penalties.
- 'Cobrastan is not a real country' — denying fake/unknown-country passports is correct.

ENTRANT OUTCOMES (decisions made)
- Day 1: Gunning, Sokolov, Ponovska (ARSTOTZKA) approved; Borch, Bernheim, Ulyamova (foreign) denied; Dalsgaard, Libet denied. Day ended by terrorist attack (scarred man: 'It was a mistake to open this checkpoint').
- Day 2: Hwon approved; Walker (expired) denied; Teroska, Convanov approved; Belovska approved (photo mismatch→warning); Bernard approved; Stinson mid-inspection when attack ended day.
- Day 3: Holland + valid ticket approved; Daisovski (no visible ticket→invisible) wrongly denied; Uvila + ticket approved; Seipke wrongly denied (invisible ticket); Isakovich denied (future-dated ticket); Shmeleva wrongly denied ('Great Rapid'); undocumented entrant refused via interrogation.
- Day 4: Mullins (valid permit) approved; Gulieva (expired permit), Sansfacon (ticket not permit), Hozerski (permit passport number mismatch), Hocking (expired permit), Rinova (permit name 'KIMENOV RINOVA' vs passport 'Tatyaka'), Costava (COBRASTAN fake) denied; Suhaila (ID card, weight/DOB match) approved; Shammas denied for missing ID card (outcome unverified).

UNRESOLVED / GUESSES
- Whether denying for a missing citizen ID card is correct/unpenalized (untested outcome).
- Whether the ledger always appears after SLEEP.
- Whether FOOD/MEDICINE selections affect family outcomes (Son/Uncle VERY SICK — warned they may die without medicine).
- Audio transcript function and how to correlate statements.
